title: Public-records request templates for ride incident reports
context: RideBelt is an open, safety-critical Hee-Lee Oss project: an optional rider-worn backup restraint (low hip belt + short tethers; optional clip-on Shoulder Module or one-piece Integrated Harness) that latches into an open seat anchor standard (RAS). ALL safety content is DRAFT and not for use until a credentialed engineer signs off at the MVP gate (GOVERNANCE.md). Never remove a DRAFT banner, never give instructions for wearing or attaching anything to a ride, never copy text from paid standards (cite by number and title only), never name private individuals or incident victims, and respect the patent design-arounds in docs/research/patentability-fto.md. Many incident reports sit with state agencies and can be requested under public-records laws.
objective: Write reusable public-records request templates (US federal FOIA style and a generic US state version), plus a table of the state agencies named in incidents.md with each one's public-records portal URL.
acceptanceCriteria: Templates are generic and name no individuals
Each agency row has a working official URL
Explains what to request (inspection, investigation, engineering reports) and typical exemptions
